notes.title: Installation Dependency Workaround
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's launch day! So exciting... so full of bugs...

I'm still trying to figure out the Steamworks installation pipeline/process, so for the time being, I've added an installation option (Launch Client Dependency Installer) at launch to resolve the rest of the client dependencies that are missed with the steam installation.  You only need to run this once, to play the game (it takes two seconds), and then you can start it again and select the 'Play game' option and have some fun! I promise I will work as fast as I can to remediate this issue so that all dependencies are resolved in installation.

Thank you for understanding!  I hope you enjoy the game!

-Amanda
